message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes based on facts: theft of public lighting cable, endangering public safety. Likely "盗窃罪" (theft) and possibly "破坏公共设施罪" (damage to public facilities) or "危害公共安全罪". Chinese criminal law: Theft of public property (public lighting cable) is theft.
